title: Baltic Sea anomaly: not attached to the seafloor, with electromagnetic activity

tellings.quote: Uh according to Dennis Aspx explorer who's a buddy of mine, uh it's not attached to the seafloor.

plain: A strange shape lying at the bottom of the Baltic Sea is said not to be attached to the seafloor at all, and to give off electromagnetic activity. Michels passes this on from a friend of his, a sea explorer named Dennis Asberg, who told him so. If true, the object would be something resting there, not a rock formation.
